chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz narrated from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, said: “A woman’s direct physical contact with her daughter, when she has reached six years, is a branch of zinā.”

key_terms.الزِّنَا: fornication; here, a grave sexual impropriety

ai.seo_question: At what age does a girl require stricter physical boundaries in family contact according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses boundaries in physical contact within the family once a girl reaches a certain age. It presents such contact as morally and legally blameworthy, emphasizing modesty and separation in child-rearing according to Islamic norms.
